definitions.geometry: unchanged integer original-RGB square crop with10percent context; out-of-image padding has zero GT
definitions.GT_fraction: original-annotation target pixels divided by padded crop side squared before Resize1024; valid RGB fraction also retained per crop
definitions.component_ownership: original1024 semantic/prediction connected-region frame; target pixels inside fixed crop and outside selected component counted on this frame
definitions.unexpanded_bbox: mapped original pixel-center membership in selected component rectangular bbox, before square/context expansion
definitions.fixed_rule: sealed CLS margin>0; no new threshold, fit, sign flip, sample removal or subgroup AUROC
definitions.interpretation: GT-containing/empty splits are post-hoc geometry description; classification of crop content is not ownership of the predicted region
